text: The report contains: (1) summary and key dates with forecast and float; (2) overall progress planned versus earned, with the S-curve (engineering, procurement, construction, commissioning); (3) engineering: documents by status and discipline, documents issued in the month, late documents, documents in CHECK REQUIRED, review codes 3 and 4, open comments; (4) procurement: status of the requisitions, purchase orders and deliveries against the need dates; (5) construction: progress by CWP and work area, mechanical completion; (6) commissioning: systems by milestone; (7) critical and near-critical activities and float; (8) look-ahead of 3 months; (9) issues, risks and technical queries; (10) HSE and environmental data (compliance matrix ALP-EPC-00000-HS-RPT-0001).
